verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs say MCP servers plug into its local agents as plugins exposing custom tools and data sources (warp-docs-18, warp-docs-7). The Oz CLI can connect agents to MCP servers such as GitHub and Linear (warp-docs-37, warp-docs-52), and agent profiles govern which MCP servers the agent may use (warp-docs-64). Missing for 10: detailed setup/configuration docs (transports, auth, config format) and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use.
